thread:
Ava: Quick sync — we need to schedule the postmortem + retro for the 03/12 incident. Who should be on the invite?
Sam: SRE, runtime, infra, product PM, oncall from that day. Also QA and CE for customer context.
Taylor: I can do facilitation if needed. Propose Wed 4/1 4:00pm PT or Tue 3/24 10:00am PT — which fits more folks?
Priya: Tue 3/24 conflicts for me, Wed 4/1 looks good.
Jamal: Wed 4/1 works for me too.
Ava: OK tentatively Wed 4/1 4pm PT. Draft agenda below — 40m total, strict timebox.
Ava: ```Agenda
- 5m: Quick timeline recap
- 10m: Root cause deep dive (runtime/inference behavior)
- 10m: Mitigations, runbook & CI gating implications
- 10m: Action owners + deadlines (post-call)
```
Sam: Suggest adding a short "runbook review" item under mitigations and a check on alert noise (thresholds).
Priya: Agreed on runbook review. Also request: please post a pre-read (timeline + logs + draft postmortem) so we can come prepared.
Ava: Will upload pre-read to the thread and attach to the invite. @Taylor can you facilitate and capture notes?
Taylor: Happy to facilitate and take notes. I'll timebox sections and call on owners.
Jamal: I'll own runbook updates and any playbook changes.
Priya: I'll take CI gating and alert tuning as an action item.
Ava: Owners so far: Jamal (runbook), Priya (CI/alerts), Sam (telemetry + perf graphs). @Olivia (product) and @Marco (CE) added for customer impact context.
Sam: I'll bring the infra telemetry and logs. FYI the noisy alerts looked related to batching changes in the runtime — want to propose threshold tuning.
Ava: Good note. Also: add an action to triage any related changelists that touched batching configs in the last 2 weeks.
Taylor: I'll add a quick checklist to the pre-read: logs location, key queries, and the failing request examples.
Olivia: I can share customer-facing timeline and impacted accounts.
Marco: I'll join and bring any support tickets.
Ava: I'll send the calendar invite today to: Ava, Sam, Taylor, Priya, Jamal, Olivia, Marco, SRE-Ops, Runtime-Eng. If someone is missing, ping here. Please accept only if you can attend or assign a delegate.
deploy-bot: Calendar invite created: https://calendar.example/evt/1782003456-retro (recording enabled).
Ava: After the meeting we'll consolidate actions into one doc in the postmortem repo with owners and due dates. We'll do a 72h check-in to confirm progress.
Priya: Can we also add a short follow-up checkpoint for runbook verification once changes land?
Jamal: Yep, I'll schedule a 30m follow-up once runbook edits are merged.
Ava: Thanks everyone — pre-read landing in this thread in ~30m. If you have agenda tweaks, drop them now. :thumbsup:
